scripts.predev: npm -w encode-config run build && npm -w segment-editor run build
scripts.dev: npm run predev && concurrently -k -n ecfg,segd,hls,api,app -c green,gray,white,blue,magenta "npm -w encode-config run dev" "npm -w segment-editor run dev" "npm -w hls run dev" "npm -w api run dev" "npm -w app run dev"
scripts.predev:electron: npm run predev && npm -w api run build
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n ecfg,segd,hls,app,elec -c green,gray,white,magenta,yellow "npm -w encode-config run dev" "npm -w segment-editor run dev" "npm -w hls run dev" "npm -w app run dev" "npm -w electron run dev"
